# Vendored PhK-Protocol C++ headers

This directory holds a **vendored copy** of the generated PhK-Protocol C++
headers so that `PhK-BattleServer` can be configured, built, and tested
**without a PhK-Protocol checkout** (for example inside GitHub Actions).

## Contents

- `gen/cpp/phk/v1/manifest.hpp` — generated by
  `PhK-Protocol/tools/export_cpp_manifest.py`. **Do not edit by hand.**
- `gen/cpp/phk/v1/danmaku.hpp` — generated by
  `PhK-Protocol/tools/export_danmaku_cpp.py`. **Do not edit by hand.**
  Carries the Thousand Night Anamnesis danmaku contract
  (`phk::v1::BulletKind` 216 values, `BulletMotion` 79,
  `BulletSpawnCommand` 96-byte POD, `PlayerShotSpec` / `PlayerBombSpec`).

## How it is used

`CMakeLists.txt` resolves the header include root in this order:

1. `-DPHK_PROTOCOL_CPP_INCLUDE_OVERRIDE=<path>` (explicit override);
2. `../PhK-Protocol/gen/cpp` (monorepo sibling, canonical source of truth);
3. `third_party/phk-protocol/gen/cpp` (this vendored copy).

So in the monorepo the live protocol output wins, and in standalone builds
(CI, downstream consumers) the vendored copy is used automatically.

## Re-vendoring

When PhK-Protocol changes the generated headers, refresh this copy:

```sh
cd PhK-BattleServer
cp ../PhK-Protocol/gen/cpp/phk/v1/manifest.hpp \
   third_party/phk-protocol/gen/cpp/phk/v1/manifest.hpp
cp ../PhK-Protocol/gen/cpp/phk/v1/danmaku.hpp \
   third_party/phk-protocol/gen/cpp/phk/v1/danmaku.hpp
sha256sum third_party/phk-protocol/gen/cpp/phk/v1/*.hpp
```

Then update the `Source commit` / sha256 rows above.

> **Important**: re-vendor **both** headers together. They are generated from
> the same descriptor, so keeping one stale leaves an inconsistent
> `kSourceDigestSha256` and can make a standalone (CI) build disagree with the
> monorepo build.
